module.modelwear.desc: 导入静态 OBJ/glTF/GLB 模型，在玩家身边 ≤4 格内穿戴或替换本地人物外观
Import static OBJ/glTF/GLB models; attach within ≤4 blocks of the player or replace the local player appearance
setting.modelwear.offsetX: 左右偏移（总距离 ≤4 格）
setting.modelwear.offsetY: 上下偏移（总距离 ≤4 格）
setting.modelwear.offsetZ: 前后偏移（总距离 ≤4 格）
ui.modelWear.fileHint: 静态 OBJ / glTF / GLB 文件路径，可拖入文件
Static OBJ / glTF / GLB path; drop a file here
ui.modelWear.previewHint: 左拖旋转预览，右拖移动模型，中键拖动旋转模型；滚轮缩放预览，Shift+滚轮缩放模型。偏移 ≤4 格。
Left drag: orbit preview; right drag: move model; middle drag: rotate model. Scroll: preview zoom; Shift+scroll: model scale. Offset ≤4 blocks.
ui.modelWear.invalid: 模型文件无效、缺失或已损坏
Model file is invalid, missing or damaged
ui.modelWear.unsupported: 仅支持静态 OBJ/glTF 2/GLB 和 cpmodel；不支持骨骼、变形与扩展
Supported: static OBJ/glTF 2/GLB and cpmodel; rigs, morphs and extensions are unsupported
ui.modelWear.referenceBlocked: 模型引用须为同目录内的本地文件
Model references must be local files within its folder
ui.modelWear.tooLarge: 模型或纹理超过导入限制（10 MiB、4 万三角形）
Model or textures exceed import limits (10 MiB, 40,000 triangles)
ui.modelWear.saveFailed: 无法保存模型，请检查本地配置状态
Could not save model; check local configuration state
ui.scopedShare.title: 独立配置码
Feature configuration code
ui.scopedShare.open: 导入 / 导出独立配置码
ui.scopedShare.scopeHint: 模型、武器动画、粒子和建筑各用独立配置码。分享码不含账号、私密坐标或库存 NBT。
Models, weapon animations, particles and buildings use separate codes. Codes exclude accounts, private coordinates and inventory NBT.
ui.scopedShare.modelHint: 模型码包含静态模型、纹理与穿戴参数，偏移总距离 ≤4 格。
Model codes include a static model, textures and wear settings; total offset ≤4 blocks.
ui.scopedShare.weaponHint: 武器动画码仅包含此模块的动画与持握参数。
Weapon codes contain only this module’s animation and held-item settings.
ui.scopedShare.particlesHint: 粒子码包含粒子轮次和参数；世界、维度和固定坐标会移除。
Particle codes include rounds and settings; world, dimension and fixed coordinates are removed.
ui.scopedShare.buildingHint: 建筑码包含当前蓝图的方块与参数，不含容器库存或方块实体 NBT。
Building codes include the current blueprint’s blocks and settings, without container inventories or block-entity NBT.
ui.scopedShare.hint: 粘贴同类配置码，可先校验再导入。
Paste a code for this feature; validate it before importing.
ui.scopedShare.copied: 配置码已生成并复制到剪贴板
Code generated and copied to clipboard
ui.scopedShare.valid: 配置码校验通过，可以导入
ui.scopedShare.invalid: 配置码格式或内容无效
Code format or content is invalid
ui.scopedShare.checksum: 配置码校验失败，内容可能不完整
Code checksum failed; content may be incomplete
ui.scopedShare.wrongScope: 配置码属于其他功能，或含不允许的字段
Code belongs to another feature or contains unsupported fields
ui.scopedShare.tooLarge: 配置码或资源超过大小限制
Code or assets exceed size limits
ui.scopedShare.assetMissing: 请先载入模型或建筑蓝图；配置码所需资源缺失
Load a model or building blueprint first; required assets are missing
ui.scopedShare.privateContent: 配置码含私密坐标或外部引用，无法导入
Code contains private coordinates or external references and cannot be imported
ui.scopedShare.saveFailed: 无法保存配置，请检查本地配置状态
Could not save; check local configuration state
ui.musicPlayer.invalidSearch: 请输入 1–120 字符的搜索词
Enter a search query of 1–120 characters
ui.musicPlayer.searchUnsupported: 当前平台暂不支持搜索
Search is unavailable on this platform
ui.musicPlayer.radioUnsupported: 当前平台暂不支持私人漫游
Personal radio is unavailable on this platform
ui.musicPlayer.translatedLyricsUnsupport: 当前平台暂不提供翻译歌词
This platform does not provide translated lyrics
ui.musicPlayer.translatedLyricsUnavailab: 当前歌曲暂无平台翻译歌词
No translated lyrics are available for this track
ui.lyrics.lineTiming: 当前歌词使用逐行时间轴
ui.lyrics.wordTiming: 当前歌词使用逐字时间轴
module.selfname.desc: 显示并修改本地头顶名字；不修改远程账号名字，可调整大小、高度和范围
Display and edit the local overhead name without changing the remote account name; adjust size, height and range
setting.selfname.customName: 本地显示名字（留空使用账号名字）
Local display name (blank uses account name)
setting.selfname.customName.hint: 支持特殊文字、符号和 emoji；仅修改本地显示
Supports special characters, symbols and emoji; changes local display only
